llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The promql.QueryEngine interface must be extended with ExplainQuery(ctx context.Context, qs string) (*QueryPlan, error) across all implementations. This requires adding the method to the canonical promql.Engine in Prometheus, Mimir's streaming and wrapper engines, and updating test mocks. Thanos and Grafana do not implement this interface directly, so they require only new endpoint wiring rather than interface changes.

FILES:
- prometheus/promql/engine.go — Defines the QueryEngine interface and canonical Engine implementation; must add QueryPlan type and ExplainQuery method
- prometheus/web/api/v1/api.go — Holds QueryEngine field and registers HTTP handlers; must add new explainQuery endpoint
- prometheus/rules/manager.go — Uses promql.QueryEngine interface; callers must pass conforming engines
- prometheus/promql/promqltest/test.go — Returns promql.Engine for tests; test helpers must implement ExplainQuery
- prometheus/web/api/v1/errors_test.go — Creates mock QueryEngine for API tests; must add ExplainQuery method
- mimir/pkg/streamingpromql/engine.go — Implements promql.QueryEngine; must add ExplainQuery using planner.NewQueryPlan
- mimir/pkg/streamingpromql/compat/fallback_engine.go — Wraps two promql.QueryEngine implementations; must delegate ExplainQuery with fallback logic
- mimir/pkg/util/limiter/unlimited_memory_consumption_tracker.go — Wraps promql.Engine; must delegate ExplainQuery to inner engine
- mimir/pkg/frontend/querymiddleware/querysharding.go — Holds promql.QueryEngine field; must receive conforming engine instances
- mimir/pkg/querier/querier.go — Returns promql.QueryEngine; switch statement constructs engines that must implement ExplainQuery
